scope: One existing local PLIC reconstruction and one global shift; restrict interpretation of the established mechanism, not a new repair-method claim
development: Already consumed E3 iid_test, 2000 scenes. Determine offsets here, then freeze the unique implementation before appended evaluation.
appended_evaluation: Already consumed 2000-scene oracle confirmation bank. Explicitly retrospective appended baseline analysis; never call it untouched or a third confirmation.
reference: Existing direct512 oracle, evaluation and upper reference only
permitted_information: Identical coarse16 property field and same legal action geometry/F512 for all arms. Reconstruction function accepts only coarse fields and F512, never continuous property shape parameters, high-resolution property labels, reference costs or oracle boundary normals.

reconstruction.method: Parker-Youngs PLIC with fixed 3x3 weighted centered gradient (center weight2), L1-normalized outward normal and straight half-plane in each mixed cell
reconstruction.source: Pilliod and Puckett 2004; corresponding author preprint section2.5 describes Parker-Youngs center weight2. This is the established first-order reconstruction, not their second-order ELVIRA method.
reconstruction.zero_gradient: L1 gradient norm<=1e-12: retain uniform occupancy for that cell, do not invent a boundary orientation
reconstruction.area_conservation: Analytically invert square-cut area to match the original coarse fraction, including 0/1 cells. No thresholding or denoising of coarse fields. Integrate exact line-cut fractions of fine512 pixel squares against the identical binary F512.
reconstruction.precision: float64 square-area integration; no center-sampled reconstructed binary mask and no resolution sweep

global_shift.fit: One scalar for target track, one scalar shared across five learned models. On development maximize all-scene safe-accepted count subject to unsafe-accepted count not exceeding the uniform arm. Ties: smallest absolute offset, then smaller offset. Report the whole bank and its empirical tradeoff; no certificate.
global_shift.apply: Subtract offset after public cost formula. A global translation leaves selection unchanged; use original uniform argmin to prevent numerical/clipping-created ties. Acceptance compares shifted cost to unchanged tau=.02.

decision_rules: Original variant/card, four candidates, stored tie uniform, atol1e-9, tau=.02; choose once then accept/reject. For fixed selection evaluate every cost arm at the original uniform-selected action; for reselection each arm chooses by its own cost, with translation preserving the uniform action for the shift.
primary_reporting: Across all scenes: recovered safe opportunities, newly lost previously safe opportunities, newly unsafe accepts, resolved unsafe accepts, net safe acceptance and eta; retain all no-safe and fully-safe cases. Report harmful changes as well as recovered members of the old54.
uncertainty: Paired scene bootstrap for target; crossed model/scene bootstrap for learned track; 2000 draws, seed2612091401. Descriptive appended comparisons, not new confirmatory p-values or inherited risk certificates.
case_audit: Retain exact scene/model/card/action identities, signed fixed-action measurement correction, model-vs-target error, and before/after cost for every recovery, new loss and unsafe event. Do not infer cancellation from means alone.
illustration: First development scene for reconstruction illustration; event tables include all changed scenes without replacement
limits: No new scenes, no training, one reconstruction implementation, no model/data/resolution search, no automatic new calibration, RELLIS/VLM/RL remain closed. Two CPU allocations at most one hour and8 cores each for develop/evaluate; finish manuscript regardless of A/B/C/D interpretation.
